candidates.change_summary: Change the deposit condition to require msg.value strictly greater than MinDeposit (>) instead of >=, so deposits exactly equal to MinDeposit are rejected and won't change balances.
Remove the require overflow check statement, which could allow an overflow to change balances differently.

Move the TransferLog.AddMessage call before updating balances so the log records the previous balance semantics and balances update happens after logging (observable timing difference if log reading triggers behavior).
Negate the require condition to require the sum to be strictly less than previous balance, preventing normal deposits and leaving balances unchanged for valid deposits.
Replace balances update with setting balances[msg.sender] to msg.value (overwrite instead of add), changing resulting balance after deposit.
